classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Find and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase and NADPHX epimerase activities, then rank representative sequence candidates using available VPA tools.
assumptions: GO:0097527 is used for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (NAXD/NNRD family); GO:0097528 is used for NADPHX epimerase activity (NAXE/NNRE family) — both are canonical NAD(P)HX metabolite-damage repair pathway GO terms.

reviewed=true (Swiss-Prot only) is applied to both GO queries to prioritize high-confidence, manually curated sequences; if either term returns fewer than 10 reviewed sequences the workflow should be re-run with reviewed=null to include TrEMBL entries.
exclude_iea=true removes electronically inferred annotations, reducing noise in the retrieved candidate set.

Ranking relies on sequence composition, charge, and motif metrics produced by sequence_analysis in the absence of structural or docking predictions; this is a sequence-level proxy rank, not a fitness prediction.
Literature search runs in parallel to the GO retrieval steps to provide biological context and surface canonical representatives or taxonomic breadth; it does not gate the analysis pipeline.
max_sequences is capped at 500 per GO term to stay within tool memory limits while covering reviewed eukaryotic and bacterial representatives.

success_criteria.sequence_analyses_complete: Both sequence_analysis nodes produce non-empty representative_sequences and metrics

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair dehydratase epimerase NAXD NAXE metabolite damage
